# ReadyStack Digital

> ReadyStack Digital gets Australian small businesses online and stops them losing work to missed calls and enquiries. It builds fast, SEO-ready websites, rebuilds slow or outdated ones that have stopped generating enquiries, and deploys 24/7 AI receptionists and AI agents that answer calls and messages, qualify enquiries and book jobs into the calendar. Also handles business email setup, SEO, monthly website care and branded social media content. Based in Sydney, NSW, serving small businesses across Australia.

## Website pricing (AUD)

Small business website cost in Sydney and Australia. Prices are one-time fixed builds unless marked monthly. Every estimate is confirmed as a fixed quote, free, within 24 hours.

Website build by size:
- 1 page (landing page): $799 to $1,199
- Up to 5 pages: $1,799 to $2,499
- 6 to 10 pages: $2,799 to $3,799
- 10+ pages or custom builds: priced after a short consultation

Add-ons (one-time unless noted):
- Booking system: $299
- Blog (CMS setup): $399
- SEO setup: $449
- AI Agent: Chat: no setup fee with a website build, $149/month to run
- AI Agent: Reception: $1,499 setup plus $149/month (most popular)
- AI Agent: Custom: priced after a consultation
- Blog and social media content (monthly): priced on consultation, based on volume
- Online store (e-commerce): priced on consultation
- Business email (Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace): included in quote

Ongoing website care (monthly):
- Managed Website Care: $99/month (hosting, domain, SSL, forms, basic SEO monitoring)
- Website Care Plus: $149/month (Managed Care plus blog uploads and priority support)

Example: a 5-page business website with a booking system and SEO setup is typically $2,547 to $3,247 one-time, plus $99/month for Managed Website Care.

## AI receptionist and AI agents

ReadyStack Digital builds and runs AI agents for small businesses, not just websites. Three tiers: Chat is included free with any website build and costs $149/month to run; Reception is $1,499 setup plus $149/month and adds real phone answering, qualifying and calendar booking; Custom is priced after a consultation and covers agents built for a specific job. Every tier includes hosting, monitoring and retraining, with no lock-in contract. The agent handles both website chat and real phone calls, and is trained on the business's own services, pricing, service area and opening hours.

Agent types commonly deployed:
- AI receptionist: answers every call and message 24/7, takes the caller's details
- Appointment and booking agent: books jobs and appointments directly into the calendar
- Quote qualifier: asks job type, urgency and suburb, then flags the high-value enquiries
- After-hours answering: catches enquiries that arrive outside business hours
- Follow-up agent: chases quotes that went quiet and requests reviews
- FAQ agent: answers questions on pricing, hours and service area

When the agent cannot answer, it hands over to the business owner by email with the customer's name, number and what they wanted, rather than guessing.

Typical buyers: trades, clinics, allied health, salons, real estate and other local service businesses that lose jobs while on site, driving or with a customer.

## Website rebuilds

ReadyStack Digital rebuilds existing small business websites that are slow, dated, or no longer producing enquiries. Rebuilds are priced the same as new builds, by page count (see pricing above). Common reasons: the site is slow on phones, it does not appear in Google, it was built on a platform nobody maintains any more, or it simply does not turn visitors into enquiries.
